name: Stud Simulator [BETA]
desc:
🧱 Studs are falling from the sky, grab them fast!
Collect stud blocks raining down all around you and sell them for cash to climb the leaderboard! Compete with others and show who the top collector is!

💵 Purchase upgrades!
Spend your earnings on powerful upgrades and new areas to collect studs faster and more efficiently. The more you upgrade, the quicker you rise to the top!

✨ Rare stud mutations!
Some studs spawn with rare mutations, some even spawning in events! These special variants are worth much more, so keep an eye out!

🛠️ This game will no longer be receiving updates.
My new game Snow Simulator has been released, I’d appreciate if you gave it a try!
